$Comment: Kill XP for Hallow's Eve's Lost Souls, on a server running MMO Skill Tree. Only that mod reads
this folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A pattern is matched as a substring of the creature's role id and the longest match wins, so
this row reaches only that role. The other three Hallow's Eve creatures already match a pattern
MMO Skill Tree ships (Ghoul, Skeleton, Wraith) and need no row; without this one a Lost Soul
would fall to the plain fallback. The value is the XP a kill is worth before any boost.
Name: Mmo_Hallows_Eve
